# Freedom BVI

> Freedom is a 2024 Fountaine Pajot Aura 51 sailing catamaran (Maestro edition, 5 ensuite cabins, up to 10 guests) available for private bareboat or captained charter in the British Virgin Islands. She is based with BVI Yacht Charters in Road Town, Tortola. Weekly rates: $14,000 (off season, Jul 10–Nov 5), $15,500 (low, May 1–Jul 9 and Nov 6–Dec 15), $16,500 (mid, Jan 2–31 and Apr 1–30), $18,000 (high, Dec 16–Jan 1 and Feb 1–Mar 31). Contact: sailaway@bvifreedom.com, 567-373-3366 (567-FREEDOM).

Key facts: 52′ 2″ LOA, 26′ 6″ beam, 4′ 4″ draft, twin 75 HP Volvo Penta diesels, 12 kW generator, 68k BTU A/C, 27 GPH watermaker, Starlink, Garmin navigation with AIS, electric winches, hydraulic swim platform, flybridge helm. Owner's suite spans the full starboard hull.

- [Trip Resources](https://bvifreedom.com/trip-resources): flights to EIS/STT, ferries and water taxis to Tortola, guidebooks
- [Reviews](https://bvifreedom.com/reviews): first-hand reviews from crews who have chartered Freedom, with star ratings
- [Life Aboard gallery](https://bvifreedom.com/gallery): photos shared by charter guests
